text_block_list.text:
On the way to deliver the application to 
the Chairwoman's office—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thanks for listening to our 
songs♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, thank youuu! I'm gonna keep 
blastin' ahead, so keep on listening~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer spotted~♪ If you're free, come 
check out our live performance!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Both the singing and dancing feel totally 
different compared to seeing them indoors, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! The Falco with Teio duo can 
only be seen right here~♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm just filling in for someone else, you 
know~ This is a special one-day-only live 
performance!
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll stick around for a few songs.
Sorry, I've got something to take care of.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer, right here! The spot where 
you can see me best!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Watch this! Yours truly is an incredible 
Umamusume who can even rock being an 
Umadol~♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Falco won't lose either~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Lovey-dovey kyun☆ Kyun☆ Love-kyun-kyun☆"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! Lovey-dovey☆

The quality of their performance was 
exceptional, captivating the hearts of the 
audience.

Singing and dancing with an awareness of 
being watched seems to be great practice 
for Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful concert♪ The audience 
was totally thrilled~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that was so much fun! Call me 
again if you ever need a stand-in!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Call them, call them~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you'd like, Teio-chan, do you want 
to join in on Umadol activities—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, Teio-chan? Where is Teio-chan?!

The moment Tokai Teio spotted Symboli 
Rudolf, she ran off before Smart Falcon 
could finish her pitch.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"You won't stay and watch?! But it's my 
Umadol Live!"
choice_data_list:
I need to go submit the application to the 
Chairwoman's office.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Booo! What's more important, me or that 
application form?!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Teio-chan. Let's do a concert 
for the other customers, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, fine, I got it. Don't come crying to 
me if you regret it~!"

I had only intended to submit some 
documents, but we ended up chatting away.

After being seen off by Tazuna, I stepped 
out of the Director's office—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! It's me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! After all, I really wanted Trainer 
to see me as an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A friend took a video of my live show! 
Let's watch it together now~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then, make sure to give me lots of 
praise, okay?♪

Afterward, we watched the street live 
footage on Tokai Teio's device, and I gave 
her plenty of praise.

Singing and dancing with an awareness of 
being watched seemed to have been great 
practice for Tokai Teio.
